Deletes a file for good. It does not go to a recycle bin.

```blitzbasic
;run
file = WriteFile("files_delete_example.tmp")
CloseFile file
DeleteFile "files_delete_example.tmp"
Print FileType("files_delete_example.tmp")
```

```text
0
```
@param file  The file to delete.
